ar.title: الفول بالبيض

steps.n1: يحمر الثوم في الزيت أو السمن حتى يصفر لونه، ثم تسكب الطماطم عليه.
steps.n2: بعد نضج الطماطم يصب عليها الفول ويتبل بالملح والكمون على درجة حرارة هادئة حتى الغليان.
steps.n4: نحضر بايركس بحجم كمية الفول والبيض، ونضع فيه الفول ويسكب فوقه البيض.
steps.n5: يدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى يحمر الوجه.

en.title: Fava Beans with Eggs

steps.n1: Sauté the garlic in oil or ghee until golden, then add the tomatoes.
steps.n2: Once the tomatoes are cooked, pour in the fava beans and season with salt and cumin over low heat until boiling.
steps.n3: Whisk the eggs well and season with salt.
steps.n4: Prepare a Pyrex dish sized to the amount of beans and eggs, pour in the bean mixture, and pour the eggs over it.
steps.n5: Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.

legacySteps: Sauté the garlic in oil or ghee until golden, then add the tomatoes.
Once the tomatoes are cooked, pour in the fava beans and season with salt and cumin over low heat until boiling.
Whisk the eggs well and season with salt.
Prepare a Pyrex dish sized to the amount of beans and eggs, pour in the bean mixture, and pour the eggs over it.
Place in a medium-heat oven until the top is golden brown.
